data_fields.name: reward_rows_in_claim
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 rows plus one fallback, in file order

best_idea: A discovery site holds an ordered list of reward rows that share one claim: each row rolls once, the first row that passes takes the site, a fallback row always answers, and the site is then swapped for a depleted version that pays only a trickle.
decision_why: The first-success cascade, the shared claim per site and the depletion swap fit zones-as-data and one-ledger, and give a loot table with a built-in one-reward-per-site guarantee; adapt by rolling on the server per claimed open, keyed to the player, with the row order as zone data; reject the donor's world-state side effects (ships and buildings on the map).
acceptance: A server test opens an intact zone site once with the gate owned: exactly one reward row (or the explicit nothing-here row) is written to the ledger, the site reads as depleted, and a second open writes nothing; a separate roll row can add a second entry only when the zone data declares it.
